svg.title: Where blue ends after red's reply, for every blue move
svg.desc: The board with its rim, the start positions of blue and red, and for each of blue's six arms and each stop angle a point where blue's worst foot ends after red's (0,−) reply. All points lie outside the rim.
svg.text: Where blue ends after red's reply, for every blue move
Each dot: blue's worst foot after red's (0,−) reply, one dot per 0.05° of blue's stop angle on each arm.

circle.title: rim plus the engine's 0.5u tolerance: past this a foot is off

svg.text: Thin curves: blue's hub after its own reply. Circles: the board's two printed rings, the rim (solid) and the rim plus 0.5u (dashed).
